# US-16 — Gitignore generated files + litefactory-owned bookkeeping directory

> **PLACEHOLDER (2026-09-05).** This is a new story added by the 2026-09-05 narrow reconciliation
> pass, in response to the sponsor's fourth refinement ("gitignore generated files except a new
> litefactory-owned bookkeeping directory"). Full task breakdown, architecture notes, and
> acceptance criteria are **deferred to the follow-up planning pass** — this file exists only to
> hold the story's place in `plan_brief.md`'s Story Index and to record its scope and dependency
> now, before that detail is written.

> As a platform operator, I want litefactory's generated harness files excluded from my repo's git
> history while its own bookkeeping (the lockfile, the index) stays tracked, so that my commits
> aren't cluttered with regenerable output while the record of what was generated and why still
> travels with the repo.

**Scope (one line):** add generated harness artifacts to the repo's `.gitignore`, while carving
out a new litefactory-owned bookkeeping directory (holding the lockfile and related state) that
stays tracked and un-ignored.

**Depends on:** US-15 (multi-worktree propagation) and US-1 (index schema). The sponsor's
refinement is explicit that this story must be sequenced strictly **after** US-15, and must not be
scheduled in parallel with it — the two touch overlapping ground (what state lives where, per
worktree) and doing them concurrently risks one undoing the other's assumptions.

**Known open questions for the follow-up pass** (not resolved here): the exact name/location of
the litefactory-owned bookkeeping directory; whether `.gitignore` entries are added idempotently
to an existing file or require a dedicated managed block; how this interacts with a repo that
already tracks one of the now-to-be-ignored generated paths from before this feature existed.
